info.name: NoShop - Complete API
info.description: Collection generated from the actual repository code. It includes the routes that exist in auth-service, product-service, inventory-service, and the API gateway. Order-service and payment-service are not implemented in the current repository and are intentionally omitted.

item.name: 🔐 AUTH SERVICE
item.description: Public authentication endpoints in auth-service.

item.name: Register User
item.description: Registers a new user. This is a public endpoint; no bearer token is required. The response includes a JWT token.

item.name: Login User
item.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token. The token is automatically saved to {{access_token}} for later protected requests.

item.name: 🚪 API GATEWAY
item.description: Gateway routes configured in api-gateway application.properties: /api/v1/auth/**, /api/v1/product/**, and /api/v1/inventory/**.

item.name: Gateway: Register User
item.description: Gateway route to the auth-service registration endpoint.

item.name: Gateway: Login User
item.description: Gateway route to the auth-service login endpoint. Saves the JWT into {{access_token}} for downstream requests.

item.name: Gateway: List Products
item.description: Public gateway route to the product-service product listing endpoint.

item.name: Gateway: Get Product By ID
item.description: Gateway route to fetch one product by id. In the repo, product reads are cached in Redis by the product service.

item.name: Gateway: List Warehouses
item.description: Gateway route to the inventory-service warehouse listing endpoint. Requests are protected by JWT validation in the service security configuration.

item.name: Create Product
item.description: Creates a catalog product. This endpoint also pushes a PRODUCT_CREATED outbox event in product-service.

item.name: Get All Products
item.description: Returns a paginated product list. Optional filters are categoryId, subCategoryId, and status.

item.name: Get Product By ID
item.description: Returns one product by id. This read is cached in Redis by product-service.

item.name: Search Products
item.description: Searches products using the required query parameter.

item.name: Update Product
item.description: Updates an existing product. The same DTO shape as the create endpoint is used, and the Redis cache entry for this product is evicted.

item.name: Update Product Status
item.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a product. Valid values are ACTIVE, INACTIVE, and DISCONTINUED.

item.name: Delete Product
item.description: Deletes a product by id. The service also evicts the Redis cache entry for that product.

item.name: Create Brand
item.description: Creates a brand record. This is required before creating a product.

item.name: Get All Brands
item.description: Lists all brands.

item.name: Get Brand By ID
item.description: Returns a single brand by id.

item.name: Update Brand
item.description: Updates an existing brand using the same fields as the create endpoint.

item.name: Delete Brand
item.description: Deletes a brand by id.

item.name: Create Category
item.description: Creates a category. This is needed before creating a subcategory or product.

item.name: Get Category By ID
item.description: Returns a category by id.

item.name: Get All Categories
item.description: Lists all categories.

item.name: Update Category
item.description: Updates a category record.

item.name: Delete Category
item.description: Deletes a category by id.

item.name: Create Subcategory
item.description: Creates a subcategory under a category. This is required for product creation.

item.name: Get All Subcategories
item.description: Lists all subcategories.

item.name: Get Subcategory By ID
item.description: Returns a subcategory by id.

item.name: Update Subcategory
item.description: Updates a subcategory using the same fields as create.

item.name: Delete Subcategory
item.description: Deletes a subcategory by id.

item.name: Create Variant
item.description: Creates a product variant for a product. This is required before inventory creation.

item.name: Get Variants By Product
item.description: Returns all variants for a product.

item.name: Get Variant By ID
item.description: Returns a single variant by id.

item.name: Update Variant
item.description: Updates an existing variant.

item.name: Delete Variant
item.description: Deletes a variant by id.

item.name: Get Product Images
item.description: Returns all images associated with a product.

item.name: Get Primary Image
item.description: Returns the primary image for a product.

item.name: Generate Upload URL
item.description: Creates a pre-signed upload URL and storage key for a new image. Validates fileName, contentType, and altText.

item.name: Confirm Upload
item.description: Confirms the image upload and stores the image against the product. Uses query parameters storageKey and displayOrder.

item.name: Delete Image
item.description: Deletes a product image by its image id.

item.name: Create Warehouse
item.description: Creates a warehouse record. Required before inventory can be allocated to a warehouse.

item.name: Get All Warehouses
item.description: Returns all warehouse records.

item.name: Get Warehouse By ID
item.description: Returns a warehouse by id.

item.name: Activate Warehouse
item.description: Activates the warehouse.

item.name: Deactivate Warehouse
item.description: Deactivates the warehouse.

item.name: Create Inventory Record
item.description: Creates an inventory record for a product variant and warehouse. The request validates variantId, warehouseId, and quantity.

item.name: Get Inventory by Variant and Warehouse
item.description: Returns the inventory record for a specific variant and warehouse combination.

item.name: Get Inventory by Variant
item.description: Returns all inventory records for a variant across warehouses.

item.name: Get Inventory by Warehouse
item.description: Returns all inventory rows stored in a warehouse.

item.name: Update Inventory Quantity
item.description: Updates the physical quantity for an inventory record using the inventory id in the path.

item.name: Delete Inventory Record
item.description: Deletes an inventory record when no stock is reserved.

item.name: Add Stock
item.description: Adds stock to a variant and warehouse combination.

item.name: Reduce Stock
item.description: Reduces available stock for a variant and warehouse combination.

item.name: Reserve Stock
item.description: Reserves available stock for downstream order workflows.

item.name: Release Stock
item.description: Releases previously reserved stock back to the available pool.

item.name: ⚡ REDIS / CACHE TESTING
item.description: The product service uses Redis caching with @Cacheable and @CacheEvict. These requests validate cache miss, cache hit, and eviction behavior without inventing fake Redis endpoints.

item.name: Get Product By ID — Cache Miss
item.description: The first read for a product warms the Redis cache. This is expected to be a cache miss on the initial request.

exec: console.log("Expected first access to warm the Redis cache.");

item.name: Get Product By ID — Cache Hit
item.description: Request the same product again. This verifies the cache hit behavior from product-service Redis caching.

exec: console.log("Expected second access to hit Redis.");

item.name: Update Product — Cache Eviction
item.description: Updates the product and validates that the cache is evicted for that id. Uses the same DTO as product update.

exec: console.log("The Redis cache key for this product should be evicted on update.");

item.name: Get Product By ID — After Eviction
item.description: Fetches the same product after eviction to confirm the cache is rebuilt with fresh data.

exec: console.log("This call should repopulate the product cache after eviction.");

item.name: Delete Product — Cache Eviction
item.description: Deletes the product and validates that the Redis cache entry is removed.

exec: console.log("Delete should evict the product cache entry.");
